routes.label: at the Transport Control Department, North Street, Hamilton

note: The Transport Control Department issues its driver's-licence card as an official Government ID card to anyone without a driver's licence. The Royal Gazette (21 September 2004) reported the launch at $15; the Government Fees Regulations 1976 as consolidated today list no fee for it (the bicycle plate line is quoted to show the Road Traffic heads were read), so the current fee is unknown, as are the card's term and the time. Tried again 2026-10-30: the Government's Transport Control Department pages list a fee for the Special Person's Identification Card (1.13 dollars, a different card) but none for the Government ID card, so the fee stays null.

sources.title: The Royal Gazette (Bermuda), New look for Bermuda licences (21 September 2004)
sources.said: The Transport Control Department (TCD) will be offering new, redesigned driver's licences meeting international standards, as well as Government ID cards for those who do not have a driver's licence. ... “Additionally, TCD will issue the cards as an official Government ID card to anyone who does not possess a driver's licence for the cost of $15,” Dr. Brown said.
